evidence: A commenter recommends alphaXiv to someone seeking help understanding papers and describes it as a better PDF reader for arXiv.

evidence_sources.author: lucrbvi
evidence_sources.excerpt: You should probably try [AlphaXiv](https://www.alphaxiv.org/), they are building what you want. I use it as a better PDF reader for arxiv paper but they are going all in on AI teaching/explaining things.
